title: Materials.
officialText:
Subslab soil exhaust system duct material shall be air duct material listed and labeled to the requirements of UL 181 for
Class 0 air ducts, or any of the following piping materials that comply with the New York City Plumbing Code as building sanitary
drainage and vent pipe: cast iron; galvanized steel; brass or copper pipe; copper tube of a weight not less than that of copper drainage
tube, Type DWV; and plastic piping.
